scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online. My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！歡迎來到《仙境傳說》。
我叫斯普拉奇，負責向你介紹基本的遊戲操作。
點選[下一步]按鈕或按[回車]鍵繼續。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你得學會控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移動、物品選擇和攻擊^000000都使用^4d4dff滑鼠左鍵^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
點選地面即可移動角色。
點選魔物即可攻擊，點選其他人即可與他們交談。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First off, try moving around.
Do you see that wooden bridge to the right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
先試著四處走走。
看到右邊那座木橋了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Walk over that bridge and there's a castle used as the Training Center.
I will be waiting for you inside of that Castle. Please come to the castle by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
走過那座橋，前面有一座城堡，那就是訓練中心。
我會在裡面等你。請自己走過去。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
你接到了斯普拉奇交給你的任務。
可以在任務資訊視窗檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will wait inside the Training Center across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我會在橋對面的訓練中心裡等你。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
同時按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可開啟任務資訊視窗。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
I'll be waiting in the castle across the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
檢視過任務資訊視窗了嗎？
我會在橋對面的城堡裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will be waiting for you across the Bridge to the east.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我會在東邊那座橋的另一頭等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Are you lost?
Have you gone beyond the bridge to the east?
I will guide you further after we meet in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
迷路了嗎？
你過了東邊那座橋嗎？
到訓練中心和我碰面後，我再繼續指導你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
My name is Sprakki and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] key to continue.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
你好！歡迎來到《仙境傳說》。
我叫斯普拉奇，負責向你介紹基本的遊戲操作。
點選[下一步]按鈕或按[回車]鍵繼續。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dffmoves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
首先，你得學會控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移動、物品選擇和攻擊^000000都使用^4d4dff滑鼠左鍵^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
點選地面即可移動角色。
點選魔物即可攻擊，點選其他人即可與他們交談。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Well then, I will give you a quest to talk to me.
After the conversation is over, talk to me again by left-clicking on me.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我先給你一個和我對話的任務。
這段對話結束後，再用滑鼠左鍵點我一次。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Sprakki.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
你接到了斯普拉奇交給你的任務。
同時按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000開啟任務資訊視窗，即可檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
檢視過任務資訊視窗了嗎？
好了，再和我談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Great!
Now you know how to move and talk to others, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
很好！
現在你知道怎麼移動和與人交談了吧？

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
The Training Center is prepared for novices just like you.
You are going to be trained to get used to the basics of the Game.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
訓練中心是為你這樣的初心者準備的。
你可以在這裡接受訓練，熟悉遊戲的基本操作。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Of course, this Training Process is optional, if you want to go straight to town, that's also fine.
But, you will miss all the advantages you can get in the Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
當然，訓練並非強制。如果你想直接進城也沒問題，不過就會錯過在訓練中心能獲得的各種好處。

scripts.text: Begin Training.
scripts.translation: 開始訓練

scripts.text: Start the game right away.
scripts.translation: 直接開始遊戲

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
Inside, Instructor 'Brade' will be waiting to speak to you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我帶你去初心者訓練中心。
佈雷德指導員會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Instructor 'Brade' will help you afterwards.
Please, Go see him.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
接下來佈雷德指導員會幫助你。
快去找他吧。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You received a quest 'Novice Training Ground -1' from Sprakki.
Please check the Quest Info Window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你接到了斯普拉奇交給你的任務“初心者訓練場 -1”。
請檢視任務資訊視窗。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
Ok, You want to start right away.
Which Town do you want to start at?
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
好，你想直接開始遊戲。
想從哪個城鎮出發？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 夢羅克

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐揚

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得島

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
I see.
Go ahead and grow stronger! Look toward a brighter future ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
我知道了。
去努力變強吧，前方還有更美好的未來等著你。

scripts.text:
[Sprakki]
These are the Novice Training Grounds.
I will guide you to the Novice Training Center.
scripts.translation:
[斯普拉奇]
這裡是初心者訓練場。
我帶你去初心者訓練中心。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Hello there! Welcome to the World of Ragnarok Online.
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
你好！歡迎來到《仙境傳說》。
你之前參加過舊訓練場的訓練。
現在訓練場已經換了新的管理者。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
I guess we will just have to start your training all over again.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
看來得從頭再訓練你一遍了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
My name is Instructor Brade and I'm in charge of giving you basic gameplay tips.
Click on the [Next] button or press [Enter] to continue.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
我叫佈雷德指導員，負責教你基本的遊戲操作。
點選[下一步]按鈕或按[回車]鍵繼續。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First you need to learn the very basics of controlling your character.
All the basic ^4d4dff moves, selection of items, and attacks^000000 use the ^4d4dff left click of the mouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
首先，你得學會控制角色的基本操作。
所有的^4d4dff移動、物品選擇和攻擊^000000都使用^4d4dff滑鼠左鍵^000000。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
Click on the ground to move the character.
Attacking monsters and conversations with the people of this world can be done by simply clicking on them.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
點選地面即可移動角色。
點選魔物即可攻擊，點選其他人即可與他們交談。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First off, try moving around.
After moving around, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
先試著移動一下。
移動完再和我談談。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
You can check the contents of the quest in the Quest Info Window.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
你接到了佈雷德指導員交給你的任務。
可以在任務資訊視窗檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
-! Info !-
You can open the Quest Info Window by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
-! 資訊 !-
同時按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可開啟任務資訊視窗。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Have you checked the Quest Info Window?
Well, talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
檢視過任務資訊視窗了嗎？
好了，再和我談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Great.
You've completed the given quest successfully, so I will reward you with experience points.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
很好。
你順利完成了任務，我會獎勵你經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Experience Points you've earned from hunting or finishing quests can be checked by tracking the EXP Bar, located at upper-left side of the display.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
狩獵或完成任務獲得的經驗值，可以通過檢視螢幕左上角的經驗值條來確認。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sigh... I will just talk roughly.
...I just can't get used to 'politeness' you know.
Don't look at me like that!
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
唉...我還是隨便說吧。
我就是不習慣“客氣”的那一套。
別那樣看我！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Ok look alive you maggot.
Next up is items and equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
喂，臭蟲，打起精神來。
接下來講物品和裝備。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
First, take these.
These are very basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
先拿著這些。
這是最基本的裝備和恢復藥水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Uh... Where were we? Oh right, let's continue.
It's about items and equipments.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
呃...剛才說到哪兒了？哦，對，繼續。
我們要講物品和裝備。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Take these.
Basic equipments and recovery potions.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
拿著這些。
這是基礎裝備和恢復藥水。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
In the upper left Basic Info. Window, press the 'Item' icon to open the Item Window.
The item window is divided into...
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
點選左上角基本資訊窗口裡的“物品”圖示，即可開啟物品視窗。
物品視窗分為...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
3 sections: consumable items, equipment and other items.
If you want to use or equip items, just double-click on the item or drag them into the Equipment Window.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
三個分頁：消耗品、裝備和其他物品。
雙擊物品即可使用或裝備，也可以把裝備拖到裝備視窗。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You can see detailed info. of each item by right-clicking on the item.
Detailed information of the item will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
右鍵點選物品可以檢視詳細資訊。
屆時會彈出該物品的詳細說明。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on an item to see detailed information about it.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
右鍵點選物品，即可檢視詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Right-click on other players to show the Community Menu and you can join a party, or request trade with a player etc.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
右鍵點選其他玩家可開啟社交選單，從中加入隊伍、發起交易等。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Why don't you equip the items I gave you earlier?
^4d4dffDouble-Click^000000 on the item you want to equip. Let us continue after you are done gearing up.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
把我剛才給你的裝備穿上吧。
^4d4dff雙擊^000000要裝備的物品。等你整理好裝備，我們再繼續。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Items can be easily equipped or used by simply double-clicking on them.
The Hot Key to open the Inventory Window is ALT + E.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
雙擊物品即可輕鬆使用或裝備。
按 ALT + E 開啟物品視窗。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
To check on the items that are currently equipped, use the Hot Key ALT + Q.
Or, drag the item on to the item slot you want the item to be equipped.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
按 ALT + Q 檢視當前裝備。
也可以把物品拖到對應的裝備欄位。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Equip all of the equipment given by Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
把佈雷德指導員給你的裝備都穿戴起來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Try to put on at least 4 of the equipments I gave you.
Put those shoes on, wear those clothes, and arm yourself with that weapon you maggot.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
至少穿上我給你的4件裝備。
把鞋穿好、衣服穿上，再拿起武器，臭蟲。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You are all set.
You are coming along just fine.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
準備好了。
進展不錯。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Here's some Fly Wings and Butterfly Wings as a reward.
You don't need these in the Training Ground, but they will come in handy later.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
這是給你的獎勵：蒼蠅翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
你在訓練場用不到它們，不過以後會派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next, are Hot Keys.
Press the ^4d4dffF12 key^000000 on your keyboard.
A box with 9 slots will pop up.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
接下來講快捷鍵。
按下鍵盤上的^4d4dffF12鍵^000000。
螢幕上會出現一個有9個欄位的視窗。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Drag on the right corner of the Hot Key Window and you will be able to see the other pages of the Hot Key.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
拖動快捷鍵視窗右下角的箭頭，即可切換其他快捷鍵頁面。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The F1 to F9 keys are the designated hotkeys.
Just drag a skill or an item onto the Hot Key Window and press a corresponding key to use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
F1到F9是指定的快捷鍵。
把技能或物品拖到快捷鍵視窗，再按對應按鍵即可使用。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can register a skill or an item to the Hot Key Window by just dragging them onto the Hot Key Slot.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
將技能或物品拖到快捷鍵欄位，即可登記到快捷鍵視窗。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Registered Skills or Items can be used/equipped by just pressing the corresponding key.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
按下對應按鍵，即可使用或裝備登記好的技能和物品。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
You can customize the Hot Key to use any keys you please as the Hot Key by changing the Shortcut configuration in the options menu.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在選項選單中調整快捷鍵設定，就能按自己的習慣自定義按鍵。

scripts.text:
!- Info -!
Register skills and items that you use often so that you can use them easily.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
把常用的技能和物品登記到快捷鍵，使用起來會更方便。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
The last part is how to use Skills.
But before that, you need to learn something first.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
最後要講的是技能的使用方法。
不過在此之前，你還得先學點東西。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
這個房間裡有個叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
去找他學習^4d4dff[緊急治療]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Your lesson is after that.
Go find Jinha and learn the [First Aid] Skill. Then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
之後還要上我的課。
先去找振河學習[緊急治療]，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Somewhere in this room, there's someone named ^4d4dffJinha^000000.
Find Jinha and learn the ^4d4dff[First Aid]^000000 skill from him.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
這個房間裡有個叫^4d4dff振河^000000的人。
去找他學習^4d4dff[緊急治療]^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Now you've learned the [First Aid] Skill.
Just as I told you before, by registering the First Aid Skill onto the Hot Key Window, you can use the skill fast and easy.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
現在你已經學會[緊急治療]了。
把技能登記到快捷鍵視窗，就能快速方便地使用。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
And that's it, that's all I can teach you.
You see that exit to the west?
Move on to the next room and there will be another instructor waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
我能教你的就這些了。
看到西邊的出口了嗎？前往下一個房間，另一位指導員會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
We will be seeing each other soon enough.
But for now, go to the room to the west and get more information.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
我們很快會再見的。
現在先去西邊的房間瞭解更多吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
You've come along fine this far.
This is not much, but take this as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
你一路表現得不錯。
這點東西不算什麼，收下當獎勵吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Next step of the Training is done in the room west of here.
If you are lost, I can send you there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
下一階段訓練在西邊的房間進行。
如果你迷路了，我可以送你過去。

scripts.text: I can get there by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己能過去

scripts.text: Please, send me to the next room.
scripts.translation: 請把我送到下一個房間

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Good. That's the attitude you must have.
You can't just lean on others to help you.
Now, go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
很好，就該有這樣的態度。
不能總指望別人幫你。
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Oh well.
I think it's better than seeing you lost and wandering about.
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
好吧。
總比看著你迷路、到處亂轉強。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Aren't you done with the courses here?
Or are you just lost?
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
這裡的課程還沒上完嗎？
還是你迷路了？

scripts.text: Send me to the Combat Training Ground.
scripts.translation: 送我去戰鬥訓練場

scripts.text: I want to go to town.
scripts.translation: 我想去城鎮

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Sure.
Be careful not to be lost again.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
好吧。
小心別又迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Brade]
Town... Eh?
In that case, I will send you to where the Kafra Employee is at.
Use ^4d4dffKafra's Warp Service^000000 to go to town.
scripts.translation:
[指導員佈雷德]
城鎮？嗯...
那我把你送到卡普拉服務人員那裡。
使用^4d4dff卡普拉傳送服務^000000就能前往城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I help you with?
Hmm? You haven't followed the curriculum correctly.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？
嗯？你沒有按課程順序來啊。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You have to see Instructor Brade first before me. I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你得先去見佈雷德指導員，再來找我。我送你回他那裡。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
I am responsible for teaching you the [First Aid] skill.
Instructor Brade asked you to learn it right?.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
我負責教你[緊急治療]技能。
佈雷德指導員讓你來學這個技能，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Wow... ...it's amazing!
You already know the First Aid Skill.
There doesn't seem to be anything for me to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
哇... ...真厲害！
你已經學會緊急治療了。
看來我沒什麼可教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Great. Was your instructor from the previous management Cecil?
Well, you have learned First Aid, I can confirm that.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好。你之前的教官是塞西爾吧？
嗯，我確認過了，你已經學會緊急治療。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Well, you can directly go to the next step of the course.
Go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
那你可以直接進入課程的下一階段了。
回去找佈雷德指導員吧。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Hello!
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你好！
有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to learn to use the [First Aid] Skill.
scripts.translation: 我想學習[緊急治療]技能

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
That's right.
First Aid is the skill used to convert SP into HP when you are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
沒錯。
遇到危險時，可以使用緊急治療把SP轉化成HP。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
It's recovery amount is small.
Still, it will help you not to faint from a critical hit.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
恢復量雖然不多，
但至少能讓你在受到重擊時不至於倒下。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
You can open the Skill Window by pressing the ^4d4dffskill^000000 button in the Basic Window.
Hot Key is ^4d4dffALT + S^000000.
Why don't you try the skill?
scripts.translation:
[振河]
點選基本資訊窗口裡的^4d4dff技能^000000按鈕，即可開啟技能視窗。
快捷鍵是^4d4dffALT + S^000000。
試著使用一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Good, now you know how to use the First Aid Skill, you have to move on to the next step.
Go back to Instructor Brade and show him what you've learned here.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好，既然你學會了使用緊急治療，就該進行下一階段了。
回去找佈雷德指導員，給他看看你學到的技能。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Didn't you learn the First Aid Skill already?
Have it checked by Instructor Brade.
If you don't know how to get to him, I will send you to him.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
你不是已經學會緊急治療了嗎？
讓佈雷德指導員檢查一下。
不知道怎麼過去的話，我可以送你去。

scripts.text: I'm good by myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去就行

scripts.text: Please, send me to him.
scripts.translation: 請把我送過去

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
Very Good!
That's the right attitude!
You will be a great adventurer in the future.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
很好！
這態度就對了！
將來你一定會成為出色的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
我送你去佈雷德指導員那裡。

scripts.text:
[Jinha]
What can I do for you?
Next course will be continued in the West Room.
Go on into the west room.
scripts.translation:
[振河]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？
下一階段的課程在西邊的房間。
去那邊看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Hmm? Strange.
Let me see that Trainee ID for a sec.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
嗯？奇怪。
讓我看看你的學員證。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Oh, really...
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
哦，原來如此...
你參加過舊訓練場的訓練。
現在訓練場已經換了新的管理者。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you want to do the basic course,
you should go back to Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
想上基礎課程的話，
就回去找佈雷德指導員吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Or you can go ahead and start with theory training.
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你也可以直接開始理論訓練。
想選哪一個？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 送我去基礎訓練

scripts.text: Start Theory Training.
scripts.translation: 開始理論訓練

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will send you to Instructor Brade.
Instructor Brade will start your basic training.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
我送你去佈雷德指導員那裡。
他會帶你開始基礎訓練。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我來介紹一下你在城鎮裡會遇到的人。
城鎮裡有形形色色的人，認識其中一些會對你有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城鎮裡的人很多，不過有幾位特別值得認識。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to the Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身後的是[卡普拉]員工，旁邊是她們的競爭對手[酷活動公司]。
第一次來到城鎮時，記得先和資訊嚮導交談。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下來聽聽他們各自的介紹吧。
先去和[卡普拉]員工談談。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Chocolat.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 你接到了巧克力交給你的任務。
請檢視任務資訊視窗。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You were still on the basic course.
You should go back to Instructor Brade or Jinha.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你的基礎課程還沒完成。
回去找佈雷德指導員或振河吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
If you don't know how to find them, I can send you to Instructor Brade, How about it?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
不知道他們在哪裡的話，我可以送你去佈雷德指導員那裡。怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I will go myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己過去

scripts.text: Will you do that for me?
scripts.translation: 請幫我傳送過去

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure. Go out to the door to the right.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。請從右邊的門出去。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Sure.
I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will tell you about the people you will be seeing in Town.
There are many kinds of people in town and some of them will be helpful to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我來介紹一下你在城鎮裡會遇到的人。
城鎮裡有形形色色的人，認識其中一些會對你有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
There are a lot of people in town, but among them, these people are the most important to know.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
城鎮裡的人很多，其中有幾位特別值得認識。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
They are [Kafra] Employee's standing right behind me and their rival company the [Cool Event Corp].
When you visit a town for the first time, you should talk to Information [Guide]
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
站在我身後的是[卡普拉]員工，旁邊是她們的競爭對手[酷活動公司]。
第一次來到城鎮時，記得先和資訊嚮導交談。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Well then, let's hear from each of them.
Start by talking to the [Kafra] Employee.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下來聽聽他們各自的介紹吧。
先去和[卡普拉]員工談談。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Here, talk to these guys standing behind me.
Start with the [Kafra] Employee behind me.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
來，和站在我身後的這些人交談吧。
先從[卡普拉]員工開始。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've learned a lot about Kafra service huh?
From now on, you can use the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
看來你已經瞭解不少卡普拉服務了。
今後就可以使用這些服務了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
During the Training Process, if you want to go straight to the town, you can use the Kafra Service to go there.
But, once you leave the Training Center, you can never come back here.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
訓練期間，如果想直接前往城鎮，可以使用卡普拉服務。
不過，一旦離開訓練中心，就再也回不來了。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Next is the Kafra's rival, [Cool Event Corp.] Staff!
[Cool Event Corp.] Staff specialize in events.
Well, why don't you talk to him yourself?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接下來介紹卡普拉的競爭對手——[酷活動公司]職員！
[酷活動公司]職員專門負責各種活動。
你自己去和他聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
After [Kafra] and [Cool Event Corp.], are the Information [Guide]'s.
They can seem insignificant but they can help you greatly when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
接著是資訊嚮導。
他們看起來不起眼，關鍵時刻卻能幫上大忙。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I've brought the Information Guide from the City of Prontera.
Ask him what he actually does in town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我從普隆德拉請來了這位資訊嚮導。
問問他在城鎮裡具體負責什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
How was the explanation of the Information [Guide]?
Last is about using [Inn]s.
There's an Inn located in each town.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
資訊嚮導介紹得怎麼樣？
最後要講講[旅館]。
每個城鎮都有旅館。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You can rest at Inns or Hotels for a small fee.
Your HP and SP will be recovered completely by resting there.
Can't hurt to use one, eh?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你可以花少量費用在旅館休息，完全恢復HP和SP。
試試也無妨，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Besides these guys, there's many merchants selling various kind of items, so go check them out.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
除此之外，城裡還有許多商人出售各種物品，記得去看看。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
You've completed all the quests I gave you.
As the reward, I will give you Free Tickets for Kafra Storage and Teleport Service.
They will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
你已經完成了我交給你的所有任務。
作為獎勵，我送你卡普拉倉庫服務券和傳送服務券。以後會用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
That's all for me.
Now, it's time for real combat!
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我的介紹就到這裡。
接下來該進行真正的戰鬥了！

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Real Combat Training will be given by Instructor Brade. You met him earlier.
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
真正的戰鬥訓練由佈雷德指導員負責，你之前見過他。
我送你去實戰訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Are you lost?
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
迷路了嗎？

scripts.text: No, just looking around
scripts.translation: 沒有，我只是四處看看

scripts.text: Yes, send me to the Combat Training Field
scripts.translation: 是的，請送我去實戰訓練場

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
Okay, come back to me if
you need me to redirect you.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
好的。如果還需要我指路，就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Chocolat]
I will send you to the Real Combat Training Field.
scripts.translation:
[巧克力]
我送你去實戰訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I don't think it's my turn yet.
Please talk to 'Chocolat' first.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
你好。
好像還沒輪到我。
請先和巧克力談談。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello.
I've been dispatched by the Kafra Head Office to help trainees.
The Kafra Corporation is the world's largest company with a long and distinguished history on the Midgard continent.
It's important for you adventurers to be close with us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
你好。
我是卡普拉總公司派來協助學員的職員。
卡普拉公司歷史悠久，是米德加爾特大陸規模最大的企業。
冒險者們可少不了我們的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I will inform you about the Kafra Services which you will be using most frequently, [Save], [Storage] and [Teleport] Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
我來介紹你最常用的幾項服務：[存檔]、[倉庫]和[傳送]。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you talk to a Kafra Employee and ask for the Save Service,
the location of where you will revive, after being defeated in battle, will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
和卡普拉職員交談並使用存檔服務後，你在戰鬥中被擊敗時的復活地點就會變更。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point is always the last place where you have saved. Using a Butterfly Wing will return you to the place where you last saved.
This service is free to use, so feel free to use the Save Service anytime you like.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
你的復活點始終是最近一次存檔的地點。使用蝴蝶翅膀也會回到那裡。
存檔服務免費，隨時都可以使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Next is about using the Storage Service.
You can store and retrieve your items in any town at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
接下來介紹倉庫服務。
您可以在任何城鎮方便地存取物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
It's unreasonable to carry all of your items with you when you don't need them right away.
Please use our Storage and keep your items safe and secure.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
不需要馬上使用的物品，沒必要一直帶在身上。
請使用我們的倉庫，妥善保管物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our convenient Storage Service
is provided to our customers for a small fee which is different from town to town.
However, you must be
at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 6^000000
to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
使用便捷的倉庫服務只需支付少量費用，
具體費用因城鎮而異。
不過，您的^3355FF基本技能等級必須達到 6 級^000000，
才能使用倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are 7 different item sections of the Storage into which items are organized: Consumable, Kafra (Item Mall), Armor, Weapons, Ammo, Cards, and Etc items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
倉庫分為 7 個物品分類：消耗品、卡普拉商城、防具、武器、彈藥、卡片和其他。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
卡普拉倉庫最多有 {0} 個物品欄位，
也就是說，最多可以存放 {1} 種不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of {0} Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to {1} different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
卡普拉倉庫最多有 {0} 個物品欄位，
也就是說，最多可以存放 {1} 種不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
If you have a Premium Subscription, the maximum Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage is {0}!
Remember though, that in the case of Equipment, each item takes up one Inventory Slot.
The maximum number of items that can be placed in Kafra Storage is 30,000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
如果您訂閱了高階服務，卡普拉倉庫的物品欄位上限為 {0}！
請注意，每件裝備都會單獨佔用一個物品欄位。
卡普拉倉庫最多可存放 30,000 件物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This Storage is shared by every character on one account.
Storage Fees can be vary for each Town.
So please keep that in mind when you are using our storage service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
同一賬號下的所有角色共用這個倉庫。
倉庫費用因城鎮而異，
使用時請留意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We also provide you with a Teleport Service to make your trips easier when you are trying to move a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
我們還提供傳送服務，
方便您進行長距離移動。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our veteran teleporter's skill,
your trip will be safer and more comfortable.
Oh and remember that the places you can teleport to vary from town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
憑藉資深傳送員的本領，
您的旅途會更加安全舒適。
請注意，各城鎮可傳送的目的地有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This is all for your never ending
support. We are working hard to
repay our dept to our customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
感謝您一直以來的支援。
我們正努力回饋每一位顧客。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Do you want to hear another explanation?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
還想了解其他服務嗎？

scripts.text: About Save
scripts.translation: 關於存檔

scripts.text: About Storage
scripts.translation: 關於倉庫

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 關於傳送

scripts.text: About Cart
scripts.translation: 關於手推車

scripts.text: No More.
scripts.translation: 沒有其他問題

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I hope you are satisfied with my explanation
about the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
希望我的介紹能讓你滿意。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you are killed in a battle,

[嚮導]
各城鎮的嚮導外貌可能不同，但職責相同。
到了新的城鎮，記得留意我們。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you want to go to your first town, you can ask the Kafra Employee to the left.
You can move there with the Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
想去第一個城鎮的話，可以詢問左邊的卡普拉職員。
使用傳送服務就能前往。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok well talk to Chocolat if you're done talking with us.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
好的，談完後請去找巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You have participated on the previous Training Grounds.
The Training Grounds have now come under new management.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您參加過以前的訓練場課程。
訓練場現在已經換了新的管理團隊。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Do you want to do the basic course,
or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您想參加基礎課程，
還是直接從這裡開始？

scripts.text: Send me to Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 送我去基礎訓練

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我就從這裡開始

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to the basic course.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
好，我送您去基礎課程。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
那麼，我們開始訓練吧。
我來填寫登記表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you came back from theory training course,
can I send you back to there or do you just want to go through from here?
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
我想您是從理論訓練課程回來的。
要我送您回去，還是直接從這裡開始？

scripts.text: Send me back to Chocolat.
scripts.translation: 送我回巧克力那裡

scripts.text: I'll start from here.
scripts.translation: 我就從這裡開始

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Ok. I'll send you to Chocolat.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
好，我送您去巧克力那裡。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then we will start your training.
I'll write down the registration form.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
那麼，我們開始訓練吧。
我來填寫登記表。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Welcome.
Now this is real practice.
We can practice real battle here.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
歡迎。
現在開始真正的實戰訓練。
我們可以在這裡練習戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
As I explained the first time, we can click on the monsters.
One attack per click.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
就像我之前說的，點選魔物即可攻擊。
每點選一次，攻擊一次。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
For convenience,
^4d4dffIf you hold down the Ctrl key,^000000 while attacking, you will automatically attack.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
為了方便，
攻擊時按住^4d4dffCtrl 鍵，^000000角色就會自動攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can also set this mode before battle by typing ^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您也可以在戰鬥前輸入^4d4dff[ /nc ]^000000來開啟此模式。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Then, let's go Poring hunting.
Please hunt 'Poring's on Level 1 of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
接下來去獵殺波利吧。
請在訓練場第 1 層獵殺波利。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff- You've received a quest from Instructor Brade.
Please check the quest information window. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff- 您接到了指導員佈雷德釋出的任務。
請檢視任務資訊視窗。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You can see it is not so hard, huh?
Nice job.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
看起來不難吧？
做得好。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Kill enough Porings.
Porings are easy to deal with, so cheer up.
Try again.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
再擊敗一些波利。
波利很好對付，加油。
再試一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Now all of the courses are almost done.
You are a Novice, and you can't get any jobs yet.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
課程差不多都結束了。
您現在還是初心者，尚未達到轉職條件。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
If you acquire all of basic skills with JOB Level 10, you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
職業等級達到 10 級並學會所有基本技能後，就可以轉職了。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The first Job classes are defined into 6 classes.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
第一職業分為 6 種。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The 6 basic jobs are
Swordman, Thief,
Acolyte, Mage,
Archer and Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
6 種基礎職業是：
劍士、盜賊、
服事、魔法師、
弓箭手和商人。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Let's experience the basic 6 jobs, Swordman, Thief, Acolyte, Mage, Archer and Merchant and see what those jobs can do.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
來體驗一下劍士、盜賊、服事、魔法師、弓箭手和商人這 6 種基礎職業，看看他們各自能做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Behind me, there are people dispatched from each of the basic Job Guilds.
These people will give you instruction manuals that allow you to experience some limited skills of each job.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
我身後有各個基礎職業公會派來的代表。
他們會提供說明手冊，讓您體驗各職業的部分技能。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Equip a manual of the job which you want to experience, and you will be able to use some basic skills of that corresponding job.
Try those skills and decide which job to choose.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
裝備想體驗的職業手冊，就能使用該職業的一些基礎技能。
試試這些技能，再決定要選擇哪個職業。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Have you tried the skills in the Manuals?
If you want to hear information about each job, talk to the people dispatched by the Job Guilds.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您試過手冊裡的技能了嗎？
想了解各職業的話，可以和職業公會派來的代表交談。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
I think you've learned enough, do you want to quit and go to your first town?
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
我想您已經學得差不多了。要結束訓練，前往第一個城鎮嗎？

scripts.text: I will stay little longer.
scripts.translation: 我想再待一會兒

scripts.text: I want to quit and go to the town.
scripts.translation: 我想結束訓練，前往城鎮

scripts.text:
[Brade]
It's ok to stay here and practice until you think you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您可以留在這裡繼續練習，直到覺得準備好了為止。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Try using the job manuals to find out the characteristics of each job's skills.
I will restore your HP and SP... Keep it up.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
試試職業手冊裡的技能，瞭解各職業技能的特點。
我會為您恢復 HP 和 SP...繼續努力。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Looks like you are ready.
I guess you have made up your mind, huh?
Well, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
看來您準備好了。
您應該已經決定好要選哪個職業了吧？
那麼，您想去哪個城鎮？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 夢羅克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐揚

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Prontera, the Capital city of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Take care and god bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
普隆德拉，盧恩·米德加爾特王國的首都。
一路保重，願神明保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
The Desert Town, Morocc...
There's lots of hidden stories within that town.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
沙漠之城夢羅克...
這座城裡藏著許多故事。
一路保重。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
You've selected Payon.
God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
您選擇了斐揚。
願神明保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Alberta, the Port City.
It's the main hub of all trades.
If you want to meet with other civilizations, you have to go to Alberta first.
Well then, god bless you on your soul.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
艾爾貝塔，港口之城，也是各地貿易的樞紐。
想與其他文明交流，就得先去艾爾貝塔。
那麼，願神明保佑您的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Geffen, the City of Magic.
Geffen Tower in the middle of the city is nice.
I will send you near the Geffen fountain.
May Goddess Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
吉芬，魔法之城。
城中央的吉芬塔很壯觀。
我會把您送到吉芬噴泉附近。
願女神芙蕾雅保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Brade]
Yeah... Think with prudence.
...Meet up with the people from each guild.
scripts.translation:
[佈雷德]
嗯...請慎重考慮。
...去和各公會的成員見見面吧。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I won't help you until you finish Brade's instructions.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
完成佈雷德的指導課程後，我才能幫您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: About Swordman Class.
scripts.translation: 關於劍士職業

scripts.text: Job change to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 轉職為劍士

scripts.text: Got any quests?
scripts.translation: 有什麼任務嗎

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Literally, Swordman means one, who
is specialized in wielding swords.
But they can also choose to use spears if they so choose.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
顧名思義，劍士擅長使用劍。
不過，想用長矛也可以。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
We possesses strong physical strength.
So naturally we can equip heavy armors and weapons.
Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods,
are equippable by our class.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
我們體格強健，自然能裝備沉重的防具和武器。
除了弓和法杖，大多數型別的武器我們都能裝備。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells.
But we've compensated for that by using elemental weapons.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
劍士唯一的弱點是不會使用魔法。
不過，我們可以用屬性武器彌補這一點。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
The merits of being a Swordman is the enormous amount of HP we have.
Most of us can bear the grunt of our enemies' attacks with relative ease.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
劍士的一大優勢是 HP 很高。
大多數劍士都能輕鬆承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
And we are unrivaled when it comes to one-on-one melee combat.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
說到一對一的近身戰鬥，我們無人能敵。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Anyone who chooses to be a Swordman will likely play the role of the tank. It is our duty to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
劍士通常會擔任坦克，保護弱小是我們的職責。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
As a Swordman you can advance to a ^8E2323Knight^000000 or ^8E2323Crusader^000000 class as your 2nd class profession.
And just recently third professions have been discovered.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
劍士可以進階為^8E2323騎士^000000或^8E2323十字軍^000000這兩種二轉職業。
最近也出現了三轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Try the Swordman skills listed in the manual.
Open your skill menu by pressing Alt + S
Make sure it is in list mode by clicking the minimize button on the top right corner of the Skill Menu.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
試試手冊中列出的劍士技能。
按 Alt + S 開啟技能選單。
點選技能選單右上角的最小化按鈕，切換到列表模式。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you're interested in being a Swordman, I'll offer you this manual.
Do you want to try the skills of a Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
如果您有興趣成為劍士，我可以給您一本劍士手冊。
想試試劍士的技能嗎？

scripts.text: I'll try the Swordman skills.
scripts.translation: 我想試試劍士技能

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Here is the Swordman manual.
I'll just take any manuals from any other classes you have.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
這是劍士手冊。
我會收回您身上其他職業的手冊。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
After equipping the Manual, open your Skill menu by pressing ALT+S.
Make sure to minimize your Skill tree by clicking the '-' button on the top right corner of the Skill Tree Window.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
裝備手冊後，按 Alt + S 開啟技能選單。
點選技能樹視窗右上角的“-”按鈕，將技能樹最小化。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so?
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our lives.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
嗯，您是這麼想的嗎？
好吧，我理解。選擇職業是人生中的大事。
想體驗劍士技能時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Do you really want to change your job to Swordman?
If you want to be a Swordman, I'll send you to the Swordman Association immediately.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
您真的想轉職為劍士嗎？
如果想成為劍士，我馬上送您去劍士協會。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you have enough job levels, of course, right?
Do you want to stop your training now and go to the Swordman Association?
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
您的職業等級應該夠了吧？
現在要結束訓練，前往劍士協會嗎？

scripts.text: I'll consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: I'll go to the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation: 送我去劍士協會

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Please try enough instruction manuals from each job class and consider it carefully.
Of course, you're always welcomed.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
請多試試各職業的手冊，再仔細考慮。
當然，我們隨時歡迎您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I see.
Then I'll end your training process and send you to the Swordman Guild.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
我明白了。
那麼，我結束您的訓練，把您送去劍士公會。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
You want me to give you a quest?
Umm. Let me see.
Ok! Hunt a couple of Picky monsters around here?
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
想讓我給您一個任務嗎？
嗯...我看看。
好！去附近獵殺幾隻小雞吧？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou received a hunting request from a staff of the Swordman Guild.
You can check the contents of the quest from the quest information window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff您接到了劍士公會職員釋出的狩獵委託。
請在任務資訊視窗中檢視任務內容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Use the 'Bash' skill in the Swordman manual.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
使用劍士手冊中的“狂擊”技能。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff"-"^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用的劍士技能。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Talk to Trainer Brutus if you want to fight stronger monsters.
I'll wait for you here.
Wish you a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
想挑戰更強的魔物，就去找訓練師布魯圖斯。
我會在這裡等您。
祝您好運。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Great.
I think that you're good enough to be a Swordman.
I'll give you some potions as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
很好。
我看您已經具備成為劍士的實力了。
我會給您一些藥水作為獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Hunt two Picky monsters.
You can find them in the more difficult training grounds by talking to Trainer Brutus.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
獵殺兩隻小雞。
去找訓練師布魯圖斯，就能進入難度更高的訓練場找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
您已經完成那個任務了吧？
隨著您在這個世界中不斷成長，還會遇到更多這樣的任務。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Swordman I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
訓練結束了。
如果您決定成為劍士，祝您好運。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
抱歉，我現在沒有任務可以交給您。

scripts.text:
[Swordman Guildsman]
If you have any questions about the Swordman class, please ask me.
The Swordman Guild is waiting for novices like you.
scripts.translation:
[劍士公會成員]
對劍士職業有任何疑問，都可以問我。
劍士公會正等著像您這樣的初心者加入。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您似乎還沒完成指導員佈雷德的課程。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: What is an Acolyte?
scripts.translation: 什麼是服事

scripts.text: Job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 轉職為服事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
An Acolyte is someone who worships the goddess Freya sacrificing themselves to help others.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事是信奉女神芙蕾雅、願意犧牲自己幫助他人的人。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Acolytes use supportive skills to make combat easier.
It is essential to have an Acolyte in any successful party.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
服事擅長使用輔助技能，讓戰鬥更加輕鬆。
想要順利組隊冒險，服事是不可或缺的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
^8E2323As an Acolyte, you can upgrade your future job to Priest or Monk^8E2323.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
^8E2323服事之後可以轉職為牧師或武僧^8E2323。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Try the Acolyte Skills with the manual you have. It will help you understand the job easier.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
用手中的手冊試試服事技能，更容易瞭解這個職業。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you want, I can give you a skill manual to experience what it is like to be an Acolyte.
Would you like to experience the skills of an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
如果您願意，我可以給您一本技能手冊，體驗服事的技能。
您想試試服事技能嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，請給我一本

scripts.text: No, I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 不了，我沒興趣

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Here you go, the instruction manual of an Acolyte.
I will take away those other job's manuals while you study this one.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
給您，這是服事手冊。
您體驗這本手冊時，我會收回其他職業的手冊。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
在物品欄視窗中雙擊技能手冊，將它裝備起來。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to know about Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
嗯，您是這麼想的嗎？
好吧，我理解。選擇職業是人生中的大事。
想了解服事的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Do you really want to become an Acolyte?
If you do, I will send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您真的想成為服事嗎？
如果確定了，我就送您去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
Of course, I assume you have enough job levels to become an Acolyte right?
Would you like to quit the Training Process and go to the Prontera's Sanctuary?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您的職業等級應該已經達到服事的轉職要求了吧？
要結束訓練，前往普隆德拉的光耀之堂嗎？

scripts.text: Let me reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: I will go to the Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 送我去光耀之堂

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
You should try out each job's manuals.
Go through them thoroughly and decide carefully.
Of course, I will welcome you anytime.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
您可以試試各職業的手冊，仔細體驗後再做決定。
當然，隨時歡迎您來找我。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
That's great.
Then I will completely end the Training Process and send you to Prontera's Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
太好了。
那麼，我結束您的訓練，送您去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Acolyte]
If you have any questions about Acolytes, please ask me anytime.
Our God, Odin awaits adventurers like you.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉服事]
關於服事職業有任何疑問，隨時都可以問我。
我們的神奧丁正等待著像您這樣的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You look like you are not done with Instructor Brade's lessons.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您似乎還沒完成指導員佈雷德的課程。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: About the Thief Class.
scripts.translation: 關於盜賊職業

scripts.text: I want to be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 我想成為盜賊

scripts.text: Got any Quests?
scripts.translation: 有什麼任務嗎

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons.
They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
盜賊擅長使用短劍類武器。
他們出手迅速，也能輕鬆閃避敵人的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies or steal items from monsters.
They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
盜賊可以學習隱匿身形或從魔物身上偷取物品的技能。
他們還擅長使用毒藥，能逐漸削弱敵人，因此令人聞風喪膽。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
In jeopardy, or in the case that thieves do not want to reveal themselves,
they can even use their skill to hide themselves easily.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
遇到危險，或是不想暴露行蹤時，
盜賊還能輕鬆施展技能隱藏自己。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
盜賊可以轉職為^8E2323刺客^000000或^8E2323流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
The class manual can help you understand what it is to be a Thief by using the skills that are essential to all Thieves.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
職業手冊介紹了盜賊必備的技能，能幫助您瞭解盜賊的戰鬥方式。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you want, I'll give you a Thief skill manual.
Would you like to experience the skills of a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
如果您願意，我可以給您一本盜賊技能手冊。
想試試盜賊的技能嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I would.
scripts.translation: 好，我想試試

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Here, please take the Thief manual.
I'll just take the other class manuals while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
請收下這本盜賊手冊。
我也順便收回其他職業的手冊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
在物品欄中雙擊技能手冊，將它裝備起來。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Oh, are you sure?
Class selection is very important so please consider it carefully.
If you want to ask about Thieves, please talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
哦，您確定嗎？
選擇職業非常重要，請仔細考慮。
想了解盜賊的話，隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Do you really want to be a Thief?
If so, I will send you to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您真的想成為盜賊嗎？
如果確定了，我馬上送您去盜賊公會。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You already reached the required job level, didn't you?
Do you want to finish the Novice training and go to the Thief Guild?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您的職業等級已經達到要求了吧？
要結束初心者訓練，前往盜賊公會嗎？

scripts.text: Let me consider it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，送我去

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Have you tried all of the class manuals yet?
If you're undecided what job to take on I suggest you try talking to all the Guides first.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您已經試過所有職業的手冊了嗎？
如果還沒決定轉職方向，我建議您先和所有嚮導都聊一聊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Ok, I see.
Welcome. Then your Novice training is totally complete and you will be sent to the Thief Guild immediately.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
好，我明白了。
歡迎加入！初心者訓練到此結束，我馬上送您去盜賊公會。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Quests?
Hmm, what will be good for you?
How about hunting some Willows.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
想接任務嗎？
嗯...什麼任務適合您呢？
去獵殺幾隻樹精怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You can't cheat this so make sure to kill 5 Willows. When you're done come and talk to me again.
If you talk to Trainer Brutus, he can send you to a more difficult training ground where there are Willows to hunt.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
這個任務可不能投機取巧，請務必獵殺 5 只樹精。完成後再來找我。
訓練師布魯圖斯可以送您去難度更高、樹精出沒的訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you equip the Thief manual, you can have the effect of the skill, Double Attack.
Double Attack and Hide are the main skills of the Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
裝備盜賊手冊後，您就能使用二刀連擊技能。
二刀連擊和隱匿是盜賊的主要技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
You are very strong.
These are not many but let me give you a reward for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您真厲害。
雖然獎勵不多，還是請收下，感謝您的努力。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Hunt 5 Willows and then come talk to me to finish your quest.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
獵殺 5 只樹精，然後回來找我交任務。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I think you finished that quest already, right?
You'll experience more of these quests as you grow as an adventurer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
您已經完成那個任務了吧？
隨著您在這個世界中不斷成長，還會遇到更多這樣的任務。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
Your training is now complete.
If you choose to become a Thief I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
訓練結束了。
如果您決定成為盜賊，祝您好運。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
抱歉，我現在沒有任務可以交給您。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guild Member]
If you have something to ask about the Thief job, feel free to ask me.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
對盜賊職業有任何疑問，都可以來問我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You are still in the process of training with sir Brad.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
您還在佈雷德先生那裡接受訓練。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants
scripts.translation: 介紹一下商人職業

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成為商人

scripts.text: Give me a Quest.
scripts.translation: 給我一個任務

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Merchant? Simply put, he sells goods and makes money.
That's the main focus for any Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
商人？簡單來說，就是買賣貨物、賺取利潤。
這就是商人最主要的工作。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We have special skills for making money.
We can buy goods at a lower price
and sell them at a higher price.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
我們有專門用來賺錢的技能。
可以買得便宜些，
再賣得貴一些。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Also Merchants can have Carts
that we can store lots of items in.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
商人還可以使用手推車，
存放大量物品。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
^8E2323Merchants can transform to a Blacksmith
^8E2323or an Alchemist^000000 as their second job.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
^8E2323商人可以轉職為鐵匠
^8E2323或鍊金術士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I think you should test Merchant skills before you decide what to do.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
決定之前，建議您先體驗商人技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Do you want to see what it's like to be a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
想體驗一下商人的生活嗎？

scripts.text: I want to test Merchant skills.
scripts.translation: 我想試試商人技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 不了，我不想試

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Here is the Merchant skill manual.
I will take other job manuals from you while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
這是商人技能手冊。
我也會順便收回您其他職業的手冊。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
在物品欄視窗中雙擊技能手冊，將它裝備起來。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Merchant skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
嗯，您是這麼想的嗎？
好吧，我理解。選擇職業是人生中的大事。
想體驗商人技能的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You want to be a Merchant?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Merchant Guild's union right away.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
您想成為商人嗎？
好，我馬上送您去商人公會聯合會。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete your Novice training and go straight to the Merchant Guild's union?
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
等等，您確認過自己的職業等級了嗎？
要結束初心者訓練，直接前往商人公會聯合會嗎？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: Yes, I want to go to the Merchant Guild's union
scripts.translation: 是的，送我去商人公會聯合會

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Ok, I hope you consider being a Merchant.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
好，希望您能考慮成為商人。
我們隨時歡迎您加入！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
That's great.
Then I will end the Training Process and send you to the Merchant Guild's union immediately.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
太好了。
那麼，我結束您的訓練，馬上送您去商人公會聯合會。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Huh? Quest??
Humm... What would be suited for you...?
Ok, then bring me ^5d5dff300 zeny^000000 by selling some of your items to the Potato Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
嗯？任務？
嗯...什麼任務適合您呢...？
這樣吧，把一些物品賣給土豆商人，湊齊^5d5dff300 Zeny^000000交給我。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you equipped the Merchant manual you have the ability to use the 'Overcharge' and 'Discount' skills.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
裝備商人手冊後，您就能使用“高價賣出”和“低價買進”技能。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
我會在這裡等您。
祝您好運！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Excellent!
Zeny is the currency of Midgard.
You can make zeny by selling loot as well as through making smart business decisions.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
太棒了！
Zeny 是米德加爾特的貨幣。
您可以出售戰利品賺錢，也可以通過精明的生意賺取利潤。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
We can use extremely powerful skills with zeny!
Mammonite! That is our ultimate attack skill!!
We basically paste money on the weapon and then strike the enemy. Death by Zeny! Nyahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
花 Zeny 就能施展威力驚人的技能！
金錢攻擊！這是我們的終極攻擊技能！
簡單說，就是把錢砸在武器上，再狠狠打向敵人。讓敵人死在 Zeny 之下！呀哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
By the way, you have done an excellent job. So, I should give you something... What would be good?
Alright! What about Phracon?
Phracon is a metallic element which you can use for refining weapons.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
對了，您表現得非常出色，應該給您點獎勵...送什麼好呢？
好，就給您一塊鋁！
鋁是用於精煉武器的金屬材料。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Zeny is the currency of Midgard.
You can make zeny by selling loot as well as through making smart business decisions.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
Zeny 是米德加爾特的貨幣。
您可以出售戰利品賺錢，也可以通過精明的生意賺取利潤。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You can get loot by killing monsters. After hunting monsters, you can sell those loot to make a profit!
What a valuable job it is! Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
擊敗魔物就能獲得戰利品，之後還可以把戰利品賣掉賺錢！
商人真是個有價值的職業，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
Why don't you try to be a Merchant? Making money is not easy but it will be a great experience!
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
何不試著成為商人？賺錢並不容易，但一定會是很棒的體驗！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
You have already completed the quest.
Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
您已經完成任務了。
進入主世界後，還能接到各種有趣的任務！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I think you're strong enough now to change your job right? Hahahaha don't waste too much time here Novice.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
我看您已經有足夠的實力轉職了，對吧？哈哈哈，初心者，別在這裡待太久。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
抱歉，我現在沒有任務可以交給您。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Guildsman]
If you have any questions about Merchants, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a rich Merchant. AhHahaha.
scripts.translation:
[商人公會成員]
對商人職業有任何疑問，儘管來問我。
我看您有潛力成為富商呢。啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You are still in the process of training with sir Brade.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
您還在佈雷德先生那裡接受訓練。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers
scripts.translation: 介紹一下弓箭手職業

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer
scripts.translation: 我想成為弓箭手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers have specialized skills by using a Bow and have a variety of powerful skills.
Archers are good at staying back and picking off their targets.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
弓箭手擅長使用弓，也擁有多種強力技能。
他們善於在後方保持距離，逐個擊倒目標。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Archers don't have great
vitality so they have to keep
their distance from enemies.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
弓箭手的體質不算出眾，
所以必須與敵人保持距離。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
On the other hand, Archers are attentive and have incredibly accurate eyes.
So once they are ready to attack, they can kill enemies before they're even aware of their presence.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
不過，弓箭手觀察敏銳、目光精準。
一旦瞄準目標，就能在敵人察覺之前將其擊倒。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
^8E2323Archers can transform to many second jobs like a Hunter.
Besides Hunters, Archers can transform to a Bard, if they are male.
They can transform to a Dancer, if they are female^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
^8E2323弓箭手可以轉職為獵人等二轉職業。男性弓箭手可以轉職為詩人，女性弓箭手則可以轉職為舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I think you should test Archer skills before you decide what to do.
I can provide you our test skill manual.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
決定之前，建議您先體驗弓箭手技能。
我可以給您一本技能體驗手冊。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Do you want to register to test skill experience?
Would like to test Archer skills?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
您要登記體驗技能嗎？
想試試弓箭手技能嗎？

scripts.text: I want to test Archer skills.
scripts.translation: 我想試試弓箭手技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 不了，我不想試

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Here is the Archer manual.
I will take the other job manuals from you while you test the Archer manual out.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
這是弓箭手手冊。
您體驗期間，我會暫時收回其他職業的手冊。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Make sure to equip the Skill Manual by double-clicking it in the Inventory Window.
Open your Skill Tree by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 and minimize the window by pressing the ^4d4dff'-'^000000 button on the top right corner of the window to see the available skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
在物品欄視窗中雙擊技能手冊，將它裝備起來。
按 ^4d4dffAlt + S^000000 開啟技能樹，再點選視窗右上角的 ^4d4dff'-'^000000 按鈕將其最小化，即可檢視可用技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Archer skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嗯，您是這麼想的嗎？
好吧，我理解。選擇職業是人生中的大事。
想體驗弓箭手技能的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You want to be an Archer?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Archer Guild right away.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
您想成為弓箭手嗎？
好，我馬上送您去弓箭手公會。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete the Novice training arena and go to the Archer Guild right now?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
等等，您確認過自己的職業等級了嗎？
要結束初心者訓練場的課程，現在就去弓箭手公會嗎？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: Yes, I want to go to the Archer Guilds union
scripts.translation: 是的，送我去弓箭手公會

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Test out all the jobs if you have to but choose Archer because we're the best.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
您可以先體驗所有職業，再決定加入弓箭手公會。
我們隨時歡迎您！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
That's great.
Then I will completely end the Training Process and send you to the Archer Guild.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
太好了。
那麼，我結束您的訓練，送您去弓箭手公會。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you have any questions about Archers, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a strong Archer young Novice.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
對弓箭手有任何疑問，儘管來問我。
年輕的初心者，您一定能成為出色的弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You are still in the process of training with Instructor Brade.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您還在指導員佈雷德那裡接受訓練。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Tell me about Mages
scripts.translation: 介紹一下魔法師職業

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage
scripts.translation: 我想成為魔法師

scripts.text: Give me a Quest
scripts.translation: 給我一個任務

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages are those who can use magic when they need to protect their friends.
Mages can curse enemies using the elements of fire, water, earth and thunder magic.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
魔法師能在需要保護同伴時施展魔法。
他們可以操縱火、水、地、雷等屬性的魔法攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
However they cannot equip other weapons but staffs and books.
Because they are too delicate
to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
不過，他們只能裝備法杖和書本，
因為身體較為纖弱，無法攜帶沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
But they can cover this weakness
by their remarkable magic skills.
That is why many people want
to become a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
不過，魔法師能以卓越的魔法技巧彌補這一弱點。
因此，許多人都想成為魔法師！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Mages have to be in their guild for guild's power and honor.
This is one of reasons why Mages are popular in any parties and guilds.
Why don't you become a Mage?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
魔法師需要加入公會，為公會貢獻力量、爭取榮譽。
這也是魔法師在隊伍和公會中廣受歡迎的原因之一。
您也來當魔法師吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
^8E2323Mages can transform to Wizards
^8E2323or Sages as their second job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
^8E2323魔法師可以轉職為巫師
^8E2323或賢者，成為二轉職業^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
I think you should test Mage skills before you decide what to do.
I can provide you with our test skill registration form.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
決定之前，建議您先體驗魔法師技能。
我可以給您技能體驗登記表。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Do you want to register to experience how it is to be a Mage?
Would you like to test Mage skills?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您想登記體驗魔法師的技能嗎？
想試試魔法師技能嗎？

scripts.text: I want to test Mage skills.
scripts.translation: 我想試試魔法師技能

scripts.text: I don't want to test it.
scripts.translation: 不了，我不想試

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Here is the Mage Manual.
I will take the other job registration forms and manuals from you.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
這是魔法師手冊。
我會收回您其他職業的登記表和手冊。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
After equipping the Manual, open your Skill menu by pressing ALT+S.
Make sure to minimize your Skill tree by clicking the '-' button on the top right corner of the Skill Tree Window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
裝備手冊後，按 ALT+S 開啟技能選單。
點選技能樹視窗右上角的“-”按鈕，將技能樹最小化。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Hum. Do you think so.
Ok, I agree with you. Choosing a job is very important in our life.
Just talk to me whenever you want to experience Mage skills.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯，您是這麼想的嗎？
好吧，我理解。選擇職業是人生中的大事。
想體驗魔法師技能的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You want to be a Mage?
Ok, then, I will send you to the Mage Guild union in Geffen right away.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您想成為魔法師嗎？
好，我馬上送您去吉芬的魔法師公會。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Wait, have you checked your Job level?
Do you want to complete your Novice training and go straight to the Mage Guild's union?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
等等，您確認過自己的職業等級了嗎？
要結束初心者訓練，直接前往魔法師公會嗎？

scripts.text: I will think about it again.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: Yes, complete my training.
scripts.translation: 是的，結束訓練吧

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Please test what Mage skills are all about before you decide.
We are always welcome to have you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
決定之前，請先體驗魔法師技能。
我們隨時歡迎您加入！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
That's great.
Then I will end the Training Process and send you to the Mage Guild union in Geffen right away.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
太好了。
那麼，我結束您的訓練，馬上送您去吉芬的魔法師公會。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
Huh? Quest?
Hmm... What would be suited for you...?
Would you like to hunt Lunatics by using Bolt skills?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？任務？
嗯...什麼任務適合您呢...？
要不要用箭術類技能獵殺瘋兔？

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou have received a Hunting quest from the Mage Guide.
You can get more information about the quest from the quest window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff您接到了魔法師嚮導釋出的狩獵任務。
可以在任務視窗中檢視任務詳情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You are able to use 'Fire Bolt' skill that is shown on the Mage manual.
I will wait for you here.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您可以使用魔法師手冊中介紹的“火箭術”。
我會在這裡等您。
祝您好運！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You have done an excellent job.
So, did you find any interests about Mages?
Alright. I will give something...
Here are Novice Butterfly Wings, please take them.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您做得非常出色。
那麼，您對魔法師職業感興趣嗎？
好吧，我送您點東西...請收下這對初心者專用蝴蝶翅膀。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
The quest is that you have to
hunt Lunatics and bring 5 clovers.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
任務內容是獵殺瘋兔，
並帶回 5 片三葉草。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
You have already completed the quest.
Once you enter the main world, you can get various exciting quests there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
您已經完成任務了。
進入主世界後，還能接到各種有趣的任務！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
This should be enough for your training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
這些訓練應該足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
I'm sorry but I don't have any quests to give you right now.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
抱歉，我現在沒有任務可以交給您。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guild Member]
If you have any questions about Mages, feel free to ask me.
I think you could be a intelligent Mage...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
對魔法師職業有任何疑問，儘管來問我。
我覺得您會成為一名聰明的魔法師...

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Hello?
I'm here to guide you about extra jobs and special classes.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
您好？
我來為您介紹擴充套件職業和特殊職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
For special classes, there are Taekwon Boy, Taekwon Girl, Ninja, Supernovice, Gunslinger.
Which job description do you want to hear?
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
特殊職業包括跆拳少年、跆拳少女、忍者、超級初心者和神槍手。
您想了解哪個職業？

scripts.text: Taekwon
scripts.translation: 跆拳

scripts.text: Ninja
scripts.translation: 忍者

scripts.text: Super Novice
scripts.translation: 超級初心者

scripts.text: Gunslinger
scripts.translation: 神槍手

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
It's a job that usually uses a lot of kicking skills.
It belongs to special class and later you can change your job into Taekwon Master which has much stronger attack skills.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
這是一個以各種踢技為主的職業。
它屬於特殊職業，之後可以轉職為攻擊力更強的跆拳宗師。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
There is a secondary class to choose from called Soul Linker which also has strong attacks.
You can decide that later when you get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
之後還可以轉職為悟靈士，這個職業同樣擅長攻擊。
等您變強之後再決定也不遲。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninja's specialty is rapid movement.
They specialize in using throwing weapons.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
忍者擅長快速移動，
也精通投擲武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninjas are kind of a hybrid class that can use various dodge skills with the capability of both physical and magical attacks depending on their preference.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
忍者是兼具多種能力的職業，可以施展各種閃避技能，也能根據個人喜好進行物理或魔法攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The biggest attraction of the stronger Novice, called Super Novice, is their pull to mediocrity.
They are the proverbial Jack-of-all-Trades but Master of none.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
超級初心者是更強的初心者，最大的特色是能力全面。
他們正如俗話所說，樣樣都會，卻沒有一項特別精通。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Super Novices can learn most of the 1st job class skills.
If you become a Super Novice, you cannot change your job, which is too bad, but you can grow as a very individual character.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
超級初心者可以學習大多數一轉職業技能。
成為超級初心者後就不能再轉職，雖然有些可惜，但能培養出獨具特色的角色。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
You can job change directly from Novice to a special class which is optimized for a long-distance attack with guns.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
您可以從初心者直接轉職為特殊職業，使用槍械進行遠距離攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Gunslingers use all kinds of guns made in 'Einbroch', the city of steel.
I recommend this for those who want to become powerful sharpshooters.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
神槍手使用鋼鐵之城艾音布羅剋制造的各種槍械。
如果您想成為強力的神射手，我推薦這個職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
If you need more information,
you can always go to ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
想了解更多資訊，
可以隨時訪問 ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
These monsters are all weak and easy to kill. But be careful, a lot of them are aggressive and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
這些魔物都很弱，很容易擊敗。不過要小心，它們中有很多會主動攻擊，而且十分嗜血！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
如果您覺得這裡的魔物太弱，我可以送您去另一個訓練場，那裡的魔物更強。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
So would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
您想試試嗎？

scripts.text: Send me to another Level
scripts.translation: 送我去其他等級

scripts.text: What monsters are there?
scripts.translation: 那裡有哪些魔物？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
I see, then let me guide you to another level. Which level do you want to go to?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
明白了，那我帶您去其他區域。您想去第幾級？

scripts.text: {0}Cancel
scripts.translation: {0}取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
You seem eager to fight.
The monster levels increase with each level of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
看來您很想戰鬥。
訓練場等級越高，魔物也越強。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 1 has the weakest monsters.
There you'll find Porings, Drops, and Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第 1 級的魔物最弱。
那裡有波利、土波利和瘋兔。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 2 is more challenging.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第 2 級更具挑戰性。
那裡有波利、瘋兔、樹精和蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 3 is the same as Level 2.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第 3 級和第 2 級一樣。
那裡有波利、瘋兔、樹精和蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 4 has stronger monsters.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第 4 級的魔物更強。
那裡有樹精、蜂兵、小雞和綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 5 is the same as Level 4.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第 5 級和第 4 級一樣。
那裡有樹精、蜂兵、小雞和綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
嗯...？
您擔心去更危險的地方嗎？這也難怪，畢竟您還是一名新手冒險者。祝您好運~

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Welcome to the Training Grounds.
You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
歡迎來到訓練場。
您現在位於外庭院，請進入城堡開始訓練。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Go, Novice, go!
Fight, and grow stronger! Look towards a brighter tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
去吧，初心者，去吧！
奮力戰鬥，變得更強！迎接更美好的明天！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Come in! I would like to welcome you to the Training Grounds!
In here, you can prepare yourself for your future adventures throughout the Ragnarok world!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
請進！歡迎來到訓練場！
在這裡，您可以為今後在仙境傳說世界各地的冒險做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Eh? Why are you still here?
There are no more courses that you need to take.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
咦？您怎麼還在這裡？
